digest.component_or_area: Architecture Decision Record (ADR) 0098 — Operation-Scoped Configuration and Provider Composition
propositions: ADR 0098 must document the approved decision that Rebar composes immutable non-secret operation configuration with separately owned provider-auth/runtime bindings at application boundaries, citing completed research and probes from relevant-liberal-xantus and maintained research artifacts.

Every external dependency and OSS behavior claim (Pydantic, PydanticAI, OpenAI, Anthropic, boto3, Git credential helpers, Jira, CI secret injection, subprocess environments) must have specific primary-source or repository citations; Rebar probe claims must cite recovery artifacts.

ADR 0098 must narrow ADR 0049 only at the per-job retrieval/composition seam and explicitly preserve all unaffected decisions regarding protocol, trust roots, producer, and SSM storage; relationships to ADRs 0008, 0014, 0041, 0046, 0050, 0059, and 0083 must be consistent and non-superseding.

The ADR must record approved decisions on operation snapshot precedence, CLI/MCP/Python/service composition ownership, provider-native pre-client auth injection, provider-specific secret carriers, subprocess environment rules, static restart/redeploy rotation, fail-closed auth decisions, and op-cert startup composition (exactly one key source, process-owned file permissions, validation-before-service, no hot reload).

Generated documentation artifacts (docs/adr/README.md, .numbers/0098, docs/architecture.md) must pass deterministic checks (gen_adr_index.py, check_adr_numbers.py, check_docs_index.py, lint, conflict markers); a numbered Draft Critique must identify or explicitly clear uncited claims, inconsistencies, missing constraints, and ADR conflicts before maintainer approval.

No RP-04 production code or implementation child stories may be created until explicit maintainer authorization; this ticket remains documentation-only and stops before HOLD/MERGE pending separate approval.
